::: {#sol-noise-twice}

Substitute $\vx_1$ into $\vx_2$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\vx_2
&= \sqrt{1 - \beta_2} \paren{\sqrt{1 - \beta_1} \, \vx_0 + \sqrt{\beta_1} \, \vnoise_1} + \sqrt{\beta_2} \, \vnoise_2 && \text{(substitute } \vx_1 \text{)} \\
&= \sqrt{(1 - \beta_1)(1 - \beta_2)} \, \vx_0 + \sqrt{(1 - \beta_2) \beta_1} \, \vnoise_1 + \sqrt{\beta_2} \, \vnoise_2. && \text{(expand)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The last two terms are independent normal vectors with mean $\vzero$,
so their sum is normal with mean $\vzero$ and covariance

$$
\begin{aligned}
\paren{(1 - \beta_2) \beta_1 + \beta_2} \idmat
&= \paren{\beta_1 - \beta_1 \beta_2 + \beta_2} \idmat && \text{(expand)} \\
&= \paren{1 - (1 - \beta_1)(1 - \beta_2)} \idmat. && \text{(factor)}
\end{aligned}
$$

So $\vx_2$ given $\vx_0$ is $\dNf{\sqrt{\bar\alpha_2} \, \vx_0, (1 - \bar\alpha_2) \idmat}$,
where $\bar\alpha_2 = (1 - \beta_1)(1 - \beta_2)$.

:::
